data.name: Actions.Common.Device.Description
data.value: The Razer device this button controls.

data.name: Actions.SwitchProfile.Description
data.value: Switches a Razer device to a Synapse profile, steps through its profiles, or cycles through chosen ones.

data.name: Actions.LightingEffect.Description
data.value: Sets the lighting effect of a Razer device in its active Synapse profile, with the effect's colours, duration or direction. Needs Synapse control.

data.name: Actions.GamingMode.Description
data.value: Turns a Razer keyboard's gaming mode on or off. Gaming mode disables the Windows key.

data.name: Actions.StepDpi.Description
data.value: Moves the Razer mouse one DPI stage up or down within its active profile.

data.name: Actions.TemporaryDpi.Description
data.value: Sets the Razer mouse to a DPI value until the next profile switch or DPI step.

data.name: Actions.DpiStage.Description
data.value: Switches the Razer mouse to one of its DPI stages in the active profile, numbered as Synapse shows them. Goes through Synapse when Synapse control is on, so Synapse shows and saves the stage; otherwise it sets the stage on the mouse directly.

data.name: Actions.CycleLighting.Description
data.value: Each press moves the device to the next of the ticked lighting effects in its active Synapse profile. With none ticked it cycles Static, Breathing, Spectrum cycling and Wave.

data.name: Actions.RestartSynapse.Description
data.value: Closes Razer Synapse and starts it again from its own startup entry, so Synapse control applies. Synapse's windows close for a few seconds. Runs only when you press the button.

data.name: Actions.Errors.NoSuchStage
data.value: The mouse has no DPI stage with that number in its active profile.

data.name: Actions.Errors.SynapseUnavailable
data.value: Razer Synapse is not reachable. Check that Synapse is running with Synapse control enabled in this plugin's settings.

data.name: Actions.Errors.DeviceNotFound
data.value: That Razer device is not connected.

data.name: Actions.Errors.ProfileNotFound
data.value: That Synapse profile no longer exists on this device.

data.name: Actions.Errors.NotApplied
data.value: Synapse did not apply the change.

data.name: Actions.Errors.Unsupported
data.value: This device does not support that setting.

data.name: Actions.Errors.MouseFailed
data.value: The Razer mouse did not accept the change.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.Description
data.value: Profile switching, lighting and gaming mode drive Razer Synapse through its local debug port. Mouse DPI works without it. Currently: {flag}. Plugin status: {status}. If the status is restart_needed, tick Restart Synapse when I save, or sign out of Windows and back in. Opening Synapse from the Start menu starts it without the flag. If it is flag_missing, Synapse removed the flag from its startup entry: save this screen again to put it back.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.SecurityWarning
data.value: Security: while Synapse control is on, Razer Synapse opens a debug port on 127.0.0.1:9229. Any program or Windows user on this PC can connect to that port and run code inside Razer Synapse, not only control it. Turn this on only if you trust every program and every user on this PC.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.NotInstalled
data.value: Razer Synapse's startup entry was not found. Install Razer Synapse 4 and let it start once.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.StartupEntry
data.value: What changes: turning this on adds --inspect=127.0.0.1:9229 to the end of the RazerAppEngine value under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run. Nothing else in that entry changes. Turning it off removes exactly that flag again and leaves the rest of the entry as it is. Both take effect the next time Synapse starts. The plugin never changes the entry or restarts Synapse on its own.

data.name: Actions.Errors.ControlOff
data.value: Synapse control is off. Turn it on in the plugin's settings first.

data.name: Actions.ChromaLighting.Description
data.value: Static colour, Breathing, Spectrum cycling, Wave or Off through Razer Chroma, with brightness and speed, without Synapse control. The lighting stays while Macro Deck runs; choose Synapse lighting to go back to your Synapse profile. Needs the Chroma module in Razer Synapse with Chroma apps allowed.

data.name: Actions.ChromaLighting.Color2.Description
data.value: When set, each breath alternates between the two colours.

data.name: Actions.Errors.ChromaUnavailable
data.value: Razer Chroma is not available. Install the Chroma module in Razer Synapse and allow Chroma apps.

data.name: Actions.Errors.ChromaRejected
data.value: Razer Chroma did not accept the lighting change. Check that Chroma apps are allowed in Razer Synapse.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.Enabled.Description
data.value: Lets the plugin switch profiles, set lighting and brightness, and toggle gaming mode through Synapse's debug port. Turning it off removes the flag from Synapse's startup entry again. Mouse DPI and Chroma lighting work without it.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.Restart.Description
data.value: Closes Razer Synapse and starts it again, so the change works right away. Without this, it takes effect the next time Synapse starts.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.RestartFailed
data.value: Your settings were saved, but Razer Synapse could not be restarted. Sign out of Windows and back in instead.

data.name: Actions.LightingEffect.Direction.Description
data.value: Keyboards move left or right, mice up or down. A direction the device does not have is not applied.

data.name: Actions.Brightness.Description
data.value: Sets the lighting brightness of a Razer device in its active Synapse profile, or makes it brighter or dimmer. Needs Synapse control.

data.name: Settings.Inspector.WriteFailed
data.value: Windows did not allow changing Razer Synapse's startup entry.
